description: Implementation of QueueApplication class managing event queue, timed events, and system event handling in the starboard namespace.

classes.name: QueueApplication
classes.description: Main class managing event queue, timed events, and system event handling.

classes.name: QueueApplication::TimedEventQueue
classes.description: Nested class managing timed events with priority queue.

methods.name: Wake
methods.description: Wakes the event queue or system event wait depending on thread context.

methods.name: GetNextEvent
methods.description: Retrieves the next event, prioritizing system events and injected events.

methods.name: Inject
methods.description: Injects an event into the queue and wakes system event wait if needed.

methods.name: InjectTimedEvent
methods.description: Injects a timed event and wakes the queue if the scheduled time has moved earlier.

methods.name: CancelTimedEvent
methods.description: Cancels a timed event by ID.

methods.name: InjectAndProcess
methods.description: Injects an event of a specific type and processes events until handled.

methods.name: GetNextDueTimedEvent
methods.description: Returns the next timed event due for execution.

methods.name: GetNextTimedEventTargetTime
methods.description: Returns the target time for the next timed event.
